prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Adapt a twin-stick game control spec across iPhone and Apple TV controllers. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platforms: iOS and tvOS. Current spec assumes every user has the same controller, labels every button A even when symbols differ and gives no touch alternative or remapping guidance. Disconnection continues the game into a loss.

criteria.task_completion: Patch capability-aware prompts, discoverable controls and pause/recovery on disconnect with touch or supported input alternatives; avoid claiming certification or controller support not established.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the game-controls guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch capability-aware prompts, discoverable controls and pause/recovery on disconnect with touch or supported input alternatives; avoid claiming certification or controller support not established.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
